entities.name: UniProt O12972
observations: Submitted sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Gallus gallus Radical fringe (UniProt O12972).
Reference annotation: Golgi single-pass type II membrane beta-1,3-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase that extends O-fucose on EGF-like repeats, including Notch; EC 2.4.1.222.
Reference annotation identifies Mn2+ as cofactor; cobalt supports some activity, but magnesium, calcium, and zinc do not.
Sequence properties: 372 aa, calculated mass 40,961 Da, theoretical pI 9.38; Pfam Fringe domain PF02434 at residues 102–363.
